title: The Depths
alt: Ethan follows his glowing map while Leo lights a steep spiral passage beneath the island.
caption: The glowing spirals guide Ethan and Leo farther beneath the island.

title: The Abyss
alt: Ethan and Leo stand at the edge of a vast blue cavern filled with glowing spiral carvings.
caption: At the edge of the abyss, the brothers discover how deep the island's secrets reach.

title: The Echoes
alt: Golden memory figures and blue sound trails surround Ethan and Leo in an ancient cavern.
caption: Voices from the past flow through the cavern walls and into the glowing map.

title: The Mirror Pool
alt: Ethan and Leo peer into a glowing mirror pool that shows magical versions of themselves.
caption: The mirror pool reveals not only who the brothers are, but who they might become.

title: The Crossing
alt: Ethan studies the map as Leo points across a bottomless chasm toward a spiral-lit doorway.
caption: With no bridge in sight, Ethan and Leo must trust the hidden route on the map.

title: The Bridge of Light
alt: Leo reaches for Ethan while they cross a glowing bridge woven from blue and golden light.
caption: A bridge of pure light appears when the brothers choose to cross together.

title: The Descent Below
alt: Ethan and Leo descend wet spiral stairs while their map and torch illuminate the stone walls.
caption: Beyond the bridge, the brothers descend below the island itself.
